articles.title: GAME DAY: Sharks vs. Preds, October 15
Preds Official Podcast: Introducing Jayden Struble
Buchnevich returns to St. Louis for birth of his child
Predators Reassign Matt Murray to Milwaukee

out.detail: returned to St. Louis for the birth of his child; scratched for this game per Blues at Wild projected lineups

away.summary: The St. Louis Blues (3-2-1) are projected to start Jordan Binnington in net for their game against the Wild, with Hofer as backup. Pavel Buchnevich has returned to St. Louis for the birth of his child and is scratched, while several players remain injured: Mailloux (hand), Tucker (knee), Toropchenko (upper body), and Dube (neck). The team did not hold a morning skate, and Binnington could start after Hofer's recent win in Ottawa.

out.detail: upper body injury, day-to-day, will miss third straight game

doubtful.detail: goalie, day-to-day, undisclosed injury, activated from IR but uncertain for play

home.summary: The Nashville Predators (2-2-2) are projected to start Juuse Saros in net with Matt Murray as backup, though Murray was reassigned to Milwaukee later on Oct. 15. The Predators scratched Jack Ahcan and Ilya Lyubushkin, and will miss Mavrik Bourque (upper body, day-to-day) and William Trudeau (upper body). Justus Annunen remains day-to-day with an undisclosed injury after being activated from IR. The team aims to sharpen details after a loss to Vegas, focusing on reducing turnovers against the Sharks.
